description: Workshop combination results: the item each combination makes.

legacy_alias.role: compatibility only; write current semantic ids

columns.name: id
columns.description: Semantic result id; pairs name it.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: The original record index: the combined item's sub id (and, for blades, its id; shields and armor add 126). Runs from 0 without gaps.

columns.name: category
columns.description: The item category: shields 0-1, armor 2-5 (the armor material table is by category 2-5).

columns.name: gem_slots
columns.description: How many gems the shield holds.

columns.name: strength
columns.description: Base strength, before the material's bonus.

columns.name: intelligence
columns.description: Base intelligence, before the material's bonus.

columns.name: agility
columns.description: Base agility, before the material's bonus.

columns.name: raw.byte7
columns.description: Record byte 7, not yet named; kept so the record rebuilds exactly.
